::: {#def-fixed-hyperparameter}

#### Fixed hyperparameter

A **fixed hyperparameter** of an experiment is a [hyperparameter](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/model-selection.html#sec-hyperparameters) that keeps one value throughout the experiment [@godbole2023playbook].
The experiment's conclusions hold for that value,
and may not hold for others.

:::
